name: windows-multi-speaker-controller
description: Windows Multi-Speaker Audio Router & Hardware Volume Sync Controller (Electron + TypeScript + WASAPI)

scripts.dev: npm.cmd run build:native && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm.cmd run build:native && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
scripts.package: npm.cmd run build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-app.ps1
